target_text: moving away from the outdated “trusted internal network” paradigm
notes: Zero-trust is already stated as verify-every-user-and-device; the participial tail restates that distinction via the trusted-network antonym and adds no new fact.

target_text: Technical tools cannot succeed in isolation
notes: Delete-and-reread: the following positive clause already says tools need policies, governance, and culture; isolation is only the rejected framing of that same claim.

target_text: organizations transform cybersecurity from a cost center into a strategic asset that safeguards reputation and competitive advantage
notes: The checkable action is embedding security metrics in KPIs and aligning them with business objectives; the cost-center/strategic-asset recharacterization is a synonym restatement with nothing further to verify.

target_text: Addressing this requires more than periodic training
notes: More-than-X is the isn't-just variant. The demand for a security-first culture plus gamified learning, simulations, and reporting already carries the claim; the training negation is filler.
Beyond-X functions as not-as-compliance-but. Ethical considerations around surveillance, bias, and disclosure stand on their own; the opener adds no checkable content.

target_text: Artificial intelligence (AI) is a double‑edged sword in cybersecurity.
notes: Not a not-A-is-B pair and not a post-hoc synonym restatement; it is an empty metaphor sentence. Deleting it leaves the following defensive and offensive facts unchanged, so the general first-half windup test still flags it.

target_text: Cybersecurity today is not merely an IT concern
notes: Classic not-merely-A; it-is-B. The multidimensional-discipline clause states the claim; the IT-concern negation is padding.

target_text: we safeguard not only data and devices but the trust that fuels innovation and progress in the digital age
notes: Surface cousin of not-X-but-Y, but the two objects are distinct claims. Deleting not-only data and devices loses a checkable conjunct, so the negative half is not filler.
